source_review_notes: Primary results support 14 MIC threshold rows: both compounds had no antibacterial effect up to 128 µg/mL against seven tested pathogens, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa which is absent from the linked DBAASP rows.
Primary text supports three approximate compound 1 cytotoxic inhibition values at 50 µM: UM92-1, NCI-H2170, and MDA-MB-231.
Figure 4 was inspected manually; exact extra bar heights were not tabulated locally and were not digitized into false precision.
DataSheet1.docx was opened as OOXML and contains structure/NMR/Marfey support tables and figures, not additional antibacterial/cytotoxicity tables.
Landed supplementary .bin files are Frontiers HTML pages, not assay spreadsheets; supplementary_text.jsonl indexes them only.
DBAASP rows using MDA-MB-435 conflict with the paper/figure label MDA-MB-453 and are preserved in the database layer as source_conflict rather than rewritten silently.
